reviews.title: So Many Losses
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for about two months and have been tracking the results from it. After 162 bets, only 70 of them won. This is a win rate of 43.21% at an average of -140 odds. That is a -25.9% ROI, which means it is not a profitable betting strategy. I would recommend staying away from this app, as the results should speak for themselves. Plenty of other options out there.
